note: This file is a configuration file (Python dict literals only). It defines dataset settings, preprocessing pipelines, dataloaders, and evaluators for COCO panoptic segmentation in MMDetection. It contains no callable functions, classes, or APIs — only variable assignments used as config references by the MMDetection training framework.
use_cases: Base config for COCO panoptic segmentation dataset in MMDetection
Defines train/val/test data loading pipelines with resize, flip, and annotation loading
Configures aspect-ratio-aware batch sampling for training
Sets up CocoPanopticMetric evaluator for validation and testing
Provides commented examples for S3-backed data loading via petrel backend
